* Each active pen pal sends 10 letters per week.
* Each letter is 9 pages long.
* Total pages per pen pal per week = 10 letters/week * 9 pages/letter = 90 pages/week.

* Samuel writes 1 page in 20 minutes.

* There are 60 minutes in an hour.
